name: Wagamama High Spec OC
original_name: ワガママハイスペック OC
source:
This is the fandisc for Wagamama High Spec, with after stories for all four heroines and new routes for sub-heroines Karen, Chitose and Yukari. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/08/01/august-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《任性High Spec》的粉丝碟，收录四位女主角的后日谈，并为配角Karen、千岁和Yukari加入全新路线。

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/08/01/august-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）
